result.instructions:
TickerLayer market data tools. One API key covers crypto, forex, stocks, indices, ETFs, commodities, perpetual futures, and bonds through a consistent schema.

Symbol conventions: crypto pairs like BTCUSD; forex pairs like EURUSD; commodities like XAUUSD; ETF codes like US500ETF; stocks always use the COUNTRY:TICKER form with the listing country's ISO alpha-2 prefix, e.g. US:AAPL, DE:BMW, SA:2222. Indices are their own asset class (asset_class "indices") with bare codes: US500 (S&P 500), US100 (Nasdaq 100), US30 (Dow), DE40 (DAX), UK100 (FTSE 100), JP225 (Nikkei), KR200 (KOSPI 200), HK50 (Hang Seng). Never request an index through stocks (US:SP500, US:KOSPI, US:NYSE are invalid). Perpetual futures are their own asset class (asset_class "perpetuals") with USDT-quoted contract codes: XAUUSDT (gold), BTCUSDT, AAPLUSDT, NVDAUSDT, SPYUSDT; they trade 24/7 including weekends and the quote is a composite across several perpetual markets. They need the Perpetuals plan. Do not invent tickers or file non-US listings under US:; coverage outside the US is curated, so when unsure call list_symbols first. A 404 means the symbol is not in the catalog.

Bond symbols use COUNTRY:TENOR (US:10Y, DE:10Y, UK:2Y) via get_bond_yield.

Timestamps are Unix milliseconds unless a field says otherwise. Historical bars (get_history) are limited by plan; from/to are UTC dates (YYYY-MM-DD). If a call returns...

interval.description: Optional. Returns the most recently settled bar at this interval instead of the previous daily bar, with its bar_start/bar_end window.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Historical OHLCV aggregate bars between two UTC dates. Valid interval pairs: 1/5/15 minute, 1/4 hour, 1 day. History depth depends on the account plan.

asset_class.description: Asset class the symbol belongs to.

symbol.description: Instrument symbol. multiplier.description: Interval multiplier. Valid pairs: 1, 5, 15 with minute; 1, 4 with hour; 1 with day.

to.description: UTC end date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be >= from.

sort.description: Sort bars by timestamp before pagination. Default desc.

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description: List the enabled public symbols for an asset class, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive substring of the symbol or name. Use this before guessing a symbol.

asset_class.description: Asset class the symbol belongs to.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on symbol or name.

tools.name: get_market_status
tools.description: Whether markets are open, closed, or in pre/post-market. Call without arguments for a global overview (crypto, forex, and stock regions), or narrow by asset, symbol, or market/region code (e.g. market=US).

asset.description: Alias of asset_class, kept for compatibility. Prefer asset_class.

market.description: Region/market code, e.g. US, GB, DE, JP, SA.

include_sessions.description: Include session phases in the response.

include_holiday.description: Include holiday context in the response.

tools.name: get_market_sessions
tools.description: Trading session windows (pre-market, primary, post-market) for a market, asset class, or symbol on a given date.

asset.description: Alias of asset_class, kept for compatibility. Prefer asset_class.

market.description: Region/market code, e.g. US, GB, DE, JP, SA.

tools.name: get_market_holidays
tools.description: Holiday calendar (full closures and early closes) for a market, asset class, or symbol.

asset.description: Alias of asset_class, kept for compatibility. Prefer asset_class.

symbol.description: Resolve the calendar for one symbol.

market.description: Region/market code, e.g. US, GB, DE, JP, SA.

tools.name: get_bond_yield
tools.description: Latest government bond yield (last rate) for a country/tenor pair. Symbols use COUNTRY:TENOR. Countries: US, DE, FR, IT, ES, UK (UK gilts use UK, never GB). US tenors: 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, 2Y, 3Y, 5Y, 7Y, 10Y, 20Y, 30Y. European tenors: 1Y, 2Y, 3Y, 5Y, 10Y, 30Y only.

symbol.description: Bond symbol as COUNTRY:TENOR, e.g. US:10Y.

tools.name: open_markets_board
tools.description: Open the TickerLayer markets board: the latest price and change versus the previous close for widely followed instruments (Bitcoin, Ethereum, EUR/USD, USD/JPY, gold, WTI oil, US 500, US 100, Nvidia, and the US 10-year Treasury yield) in one interactive view. Use it when the user asks for a broad market overview or to open TickerLayer. For one specific instrument call get_snapshot instead: the board makes one data request per row.

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Search the symbols this account can read across crypto, forex, stocks, indices, ETFs, commodities, and perpetuals by ticker or name, best matches first. Powers the search box of the Markets board.

query.description: Ticker or name, e.g. KO, gold, EURUSD.
